gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.299: Combat mode: press ` (left of 1) to fight up close. Left click throws a four-hit string, and the fourth blow sends a foe flying. Hold jump as the fourth lands for an uppercut, or land it in mid-air to slam them down. Alt dashes, or breaks free while you're being hit. Hold F to block, and tap it just before a blow lands to stagger the attacker. Press ` again to fight your usual way.
